Miriam (sales_eng): Quick sync — ACME trial scope: they want 1) search summarization in product, 2) policy-compliant answer generation, 3) latency <350ms p95. Need final success criteria + golden prompt set by EOD Wed.
Eli (solutions): Can you clarify core workflows? i.e., single-turn QA vs multi-turn session context?
Miriam (sales_eng): Mostly single-turn QA for now, but history of last 3 messages used for context on highlights.
Priya (product): For eval harness proposal: propose 3 sets — Golden (50 hand-labeled), Edge (30 tricky/legal), Adversarial (20 prompt attacks). Auto metrics + human score.
Sam (sales): Pricing ask from customer: pilot credit for 30-days, plus optional Dedicated slot if throughput > X. @Miriam want me to surface committed discount number?
Miriam (sales_eng): Yes — list two options in the proposal: 1) no-commit hosted pilot (usage credits), 2) 3-month reserved for Dedicated (discount tier). I'll draft numbers.
Jordan (security): Security questionnaire notes: they will ask about data residency, KMS/HSM key control, retention windows, customer audit access. We should attach SOC2 cert + SSO SAML doc. I'll take the SQ. Need answers by Fri COB.
Priya (product): Scoring rubric idea: automated precision/recall on extraction fields, ROUGE-L for summaries, and 1-5 human quality score for correctness & safety. Acceptance gates: human >=4.0 avg AND ROUGE-L >= 0.6 OR exact-match >= 0.7 for key fields.
Eli (solutions): Suggest regression gate: any metric drop >3% vs baseline fails rollout. Also block if any safety regression (new unsafe outputs) > 0.5% of sample.
Miriam (sales_eng): Good. Put that in writing — we'll use baseline from current model v1.2 on golden set.
Sam (sales): For the golden dataset, do we have customer-provided examples? they said yes — ~30 sample tickets + we add 20 canned edge cases.
Priya (product): Timeline proposal: Mon-Wed gather golden set & label; Thu-Fri run baseline; next Mon run candidate models + scoring; Tue present results + go/no-go.
Jordan (security): Also add a data-flow diagram and list of third-party subprocessors. I'll attach in the SQ.
Eli (solutions): Implementation note: harness will run via our eval runner, config like: ```
- dataset: s3://acme/golden.jsonl
- metrics: [rouge_l, exact_match, human_score]
- human_review_sample: 100
- regression_threshold: 0.03
```
Priya (product): Human review plan: 25 random + 25 edge for each candidate. Provide template for annotators (correctness, hallucination, safety).
Miriam (sales_eng): Action items: @Eli curate prompts & config, @Priya write scoring doc, @Jordan complete SQ answers, @Sam confirm pricing options with legal. I'll compile and send proposal to ACME by Fri EOD.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for eval harness runner on staging at 2024-05-02T02:00:00Z :rocket:
Sam (sales): LGTM — I'll ping ACME about sample upload and confirm timeline. :thumbsup:
Priya (product): One more: add a regression playbook: if candidate fails gate, fallback route to model v1.2 and notify on-call.
Miriam (sales_eng): Perfect. Thanks team — will loop in the customer on timing.
